title: Permissions in a training copy: allow reads and reject edits
goal: Specify and test a minimal reader matrix in an own infobase, separate from the Nexus account.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Grant object/action access rather than rely on button visibility.
Compare an allowed read with rejection of a valid edit.
Preserve administration access and avoid changing real accounts.
sections: An operator creates and reads requests; a consultant configures variants; a developer changes configuration. These are teaching roles, not a complete production policy. Specify object, action and data scope per operation. Full access for everyone hides the symptom rather than solving responsibility boundaries.

The reader opens an existing request but cannot edit it. This differs from an input operator: define the task before granting access. Reading and editing are separate actions. A valid 30-to-31 edit is used so a duration-boundary refusal cannot masquerade as an access denial.

Hiding a command can improve UI, but denial must apply to the operation. Another list or programmatic route must not bypass the rule. Denying everything is also incorrect. Alongside each denial, test a necessary allowed operation for the same role.

A role is configuration metadata; an infobase user receives one or more roles. Additional roles can grant more access than the new reader role alone. Assign only the reader role to that teaching profile. Preserve a DT and administration access beforehand; do not replace real profiles or roles.

Training edition limits authentication and simultaneous sessions. It can teach role structure and scenarios but does not establish a complete multi-user security PASS. Execute the matrix in a permitted environment with separate teaching users. Never use real credentials or publish a password to simplify reproduction.

NexusA6Admin/NexusA6Reader belong only to this own copy. They are not Nexus, Yandex, Windows or production authentication accounts. The official training route does not depend on passwords or Windows authentication. With another authorized edition, retain its existing protection and use a separate teaching instance under its rules.

An operator may not change schema or delete a catalog. Record state before the attempt, observed denial and state afterwards. Login failure does not prove object permissions: first authenticate as the intended role and execute an allowed workflow. Distinguish environment failure, permission denial and business validation.

The narrow matrix requires an actual read, rejection of a valid edit and an administrator reread of the original 30 minutes. A login failure alone proves none of that. This exercise creates no row-level restriction: the reader may see all documents its object permissions allow. It does not establish multi-user server security.

lab.title: A reader sees the request but cannot change 30 to 31
lab.environment: Own original service desk; synthetic records only. No real Nexus accounts, Windows identities or external services are changed.
steps: Save a DT and restore a separate base through module 1. Verify its path and available administration access. Leave real profiles, source roles and source base intact.

Add УчебныйАдминистраторA6 for servicing only this copy and УчебныйЧитательA6. For the reader allow the needed client, Read/View on Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги; no update/insert/delete. Retain earlier roles.

First ensure a teaching NexusA6Admin profile with the administration role, then NexusA6Reader with only the reader role. Respect training-edition limits: this exercise configures no passwords or Windows authentication. Never overwrite existing profiles.
Close this copy’s administrator session, open as the teaching reader and read an own saved 30-minute request. Record its actual number.
If editing is available, try 31 and save; expect denial. If editing is unavailable, record that without bypassing it. Exit the teaching profile, open as administrator and reread the original 30.
expected: Separate base and retained source identified.
Reader matrix permits reading without editing.
Teaching identities and roles are separated.
evidence: Actual versions and distinct own-copy paths; synthetic identities and before/after values.
Allowed/refused cases, completed controls and explicit untested scope; no secrets.
lab.negative: Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.

mistakes: An unavailable button is treated as proof of every permission.
Check an allowed read and persistent state, explicitly recording untested paths.
The reader also receives an administrator role.
Inspect all assigned roles and retain only the intended teaching role.
1C teaching profiles are mistaken for Nexus account roles.
Separate infobase profiles from platform accounts and retain real identities.
